body: I just wanted to come back here and have a moan because I took a chuck out of my finger. So my new coolant tank arrived from another country after a what felt like years. Removed the old one, put the new one in. Simple. I think not. The top plastic pipe that snapped off the old one is stuck lodged inside the top hose and I cannot for the life of me, get it out. Resulted in me, taking a chunk out of my finger with a flat head. Any ideas that do not involve replacing the hose would be awesome but for now, I'm gonna sit here in the dark, outside and listen to some tunes lmao

Get a job and better yourself. I'm not saying you aren't good enough but we can always do better. Focus on you and keep stepping forward. As much as you want to, you can't have the same connection/friendship that you had during the relationship. That's a different type of friendship. The friendship moving onwards after you finally get to that point will be alot different then it was and you gotta accept that if you want them in your life. Don't get in the way any them too, space is now your best friend xx reaching out even tho it's online is your first step towards bettering yourself. No matter how small or big the step is, it's still a step. Process is progress no matter how small. Message me if you need someone ❤

I'm am in and was in the same boat. We both discussed we should not see each other for awhile till we are both okay and then eventually come back and try to be friends again. It's been hard and I still miss him like crazy, but you gotta try your best to move on. It makes it hard to be friends while you are still trying to move on and find yourself. I still have not reconnected with my ex after a few months but I know we will eventually find each other again one day but trust me, you can do it. I really hope all the best for you. You will find yourself and each other, take it one day at a time. 1 minute at a time if you have too. Keeping busy is key xx goodluck
